dedupe_keys.name: average bicycle counts by day and hour

description: Average Bicycle Counts by Day and Hour is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. This dataset contains average counts of bicycle traffic by hour of the day and day of the week. Data is collected from bicycle counters across approximately 16 active transport sites. As more sites come on line in the future these will be added to the dataset. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are TMR, active, bicycle, transport. It offers 11 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
